# GO and KEGG annotation of background genes.

GO and KEGG annotation of background genes.

## Usage

``` r
data(gene_go_kegg2)
```

## Format

Dataframe: GO and KEGG annotation of background genes (1st-col: Genes,
2nd-col: biological_process, 3rd-col: cellular_component, 4th-col:
molecular_function, 5th-col: kegg_pathway).

## References

https://github.com/BioSciTools/BioSciToolsDatasets/tree/main/GOenrichStat/

## Author

benben-miao

## Examples

``` r
# 1. Library TOmicsVis package
library(TOmicsVis)

# 2. Load example data
data(gene_go_kegg2)
```
